comment: Budgets in bytes. Raise deliberately, never to make CI pass. 2026-11-17: shipped 511.7 -> 517.0 KB and mobile 149.5 -> 152.0 KB for the motion system (S24-05: two keyframes and the overlay classes in theme.css) and the platform gates (S24-04); measured growth was 0.7 KB shipped and 0.8 KB mobile, the rest is headroom. Same day: initial 210.9 -> 213.5 KB and shipped 515.0 -> 517.0 KB for the alert-rule editor (S24-11: the rules list, its three selects and two numeric fields, plus the connectivity card in the diagnosis dialog); measured growth 1.6 KB initial and 2.4 KB shipped. Same day again: shipped 517.0 -> 520.0 KB and initial 213.5 -> 214.5 KB for the notification-channel editor (S24-11: a destination list with a kind and a severity select, name, URL and secret fields, and the test button); measured growth 0.9 KB shipped and 0.6 KB initial. 2026-11-19: initial 214.5 -> 215.0 KB, shipped 520.0 -> 522.0 KB and installer 5,746.5 -> 5,808.0 KB for the MQTT settings screen and the capability gating (S24-13, S24-04) in the webview, and for the MCP server plus the absence ripple in the binary - the desktop links vitals-server, so the new read-only MCP route is installed with the app. Measured growth: 0.2 KB initial, 0.6 KB shipped, 59.1 KB installer; the installer figure is the honest price of shipping the MCP route inside the app rather than as a separate binary. 2026-11-19: initial 215.0 -> 216.0 KB and shipped 522.0 -> 523.0 KB for the Task Manager move warning copy (moving a per-machine copy to per-user turns the Task Manager replacement off, and the Settings pane now says so); measured 215.3 KB initial and 522.0 KB shipped, so both were raised to the next whole KiB rather than by the script's 5 percent, which would have cost 11 KB of headroom for a 0.3 KB change.
